snippet.title: Fate/hollow ataraxia REMASTERED Release Announcement PV
snippet.description:
Relive the four days of destiny...

Fate/hollow ataraxia REMASTERED release in August 7, 2025
*This title is a remaster of the original PlayStation Vita title "Fate/hollow ataraxia" and is available for the first time in English and Simplified Chinese
